expected_posture: keep source and admitted Evidence material outside automatic workspace maintenance

execution_gate.required_before_provider_acceptance: Execute the same corpus against a pinned candidate implementation, retain raw observed outputs, inspect false positives and boundary violations, and review the results before any provider binding or automatic write capability is considered.
execution_gate.static_tests_can_prove: The qualification corpus, intended scope and forbidden effects remain explicit and bounded.
execution_gate.static_tests_cannot_prove: Graph accuracy, health precision, semantic contradiction quality, performance or absence of runtime boundary violations.
execution_gate.forbidden_shortcut: Do not treat this fixture, documentation presence or passing static regressions as provider qualification.
